observations.value: Decision (accepted Oct 17, 2026; recorded Oct 18): on three-member clusters of LXD 5.21.8 and 6.9 every member forwards every call the plugin makes (instance read, files API, PATCH with If-Match, the filtered list), with no redirect, so a cluster is one servers entry with no cluster logic in the client (FR-S11; T21's redirect retry dropped). location is correct within 1 s after a cold move, an evacuation and a restore, and is compared between reads (FR-S10, FR-S14; new reason instance_moved); volatile.uuid, its generation, the cloud-init id and the idmap survive moves and evacuations. Instance reads never failed during a move; a VM's files API answered 500 for 25-30 s after an evacuation, handled as VM start-up. volatile.cluster.group records a placement request, not membership, and is withdrawn as a claim. Live migration is untested. Evidence: runs 20261016T182319Z-g-l11-c5-*, 20261016T194304Z-g-l11-c6-*.
